verses.text: Paul here—Jesus Christ’s servant, called to be an apostle and set apart to bring God’s Good News.
God had this Good News on deck from way back, promised through his prophets in the holy Scriptures.
It’s about God’s Son, who came through David’s family as a human being.
Then the Spirit of holiness declared him God’s Son with power by raising him from the dead: Jesus Christ our Lord.
Through Jesus, we got grace and the call to be apostles, bringing every nation to trust and obey him for his name’s sake.
And yeah, you’re among the people called to belong to Jesus Christ.
This letter’s for all of you in Rome, loved by God and called to be his holy people. Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
First up, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you—your faith is getting talked about everywhere.
God can back me up: I serve him with my whole heart by sharing the Good News about his Son, and I keep mentioning you in my prayers.
I’m asking that, if God gives the green light, I’ll finally make it over to see you.
I’ve been wanting to see you for real, so I can share a spiritual gift that’ll help your faith stand strong—
though really, we’ll be building each other up: your faith will encourage me, and mine will encourage you.
Family, I don’t want you out of the loop: I’ve planned to visit plenty of times, but something kept getting in the way. I want to see some fruit among you too, like I have with other Gentiles.
I owe this Good News to Greeks and non-Greeks, to the wise and the not-so-wise.
So, as far as it’s up to me, I’m ready to preach to you in Rome too.
I’m not ashamed of Christ’s Good News, no cap. It’s God’s power to save everyone who believes—the Jew first, and also the Greek.
In this Good News, God shows how he makes people right through faith, start to finish. Scripture says, “The righteous will live by faith.”
God’s anger is being revealed from heaven against all the ungodliness and injustice of people who keep shoving the truth down.
What people can know about God is right there in plain view, because God has made it clear to them.
Ever since creation, God’s invisible qualities have been on display in what he made—his endless power and divine nature. So nobody gets to say, “I had no clue.”
They knew God, but didn’t honor him as God or even say thanks. Their thinking went in circles, and their foolish hearts got dark.
They claimed they were the smart ones, but ended up looking foolish.
They traded the glory of the immortal God for images of mortal people, birds, animals, and crawling things.
So God let them follow the dirty desires in their hearts and dishonor their own bodies.
They swapped God’s truth for a lie, then worshiped and served creation instead of the Creator—who is blessed forever. Amen.
That’s why God let them follow degrading desires. The women traded natural relations for relations against nature.
Same with the men: they left natural relations with women and burned with desire for each other. Men did shameful things with men and brought the consequences of their error on themselves.
They didn’t want to keep God in their knowledge, so God let them follow a twisted way of thinking and do what shouldn’t be done.
They got filled up with injustice, sexual wrongdoing, evil, greed, and malice—envy, murder, fights, lies, bad habits, and whisper campaigns.
They slandered, hated God, insulted people, acted stuck-up and boastful, invented new ways to do evil, and disobeyed their parents.
They had no sense, broke promises, lacked natural affection, and showed no mercy.
They know God’s judgment: people who do this deserve death. Still, they keep doing it—and cheer others on when they do it too.
